item_name: Rothco Deluxe Low Profile Afghanistan Vet Cap
item_short_desc: Show your pride with Rothco’s Deluxe Low Profile Afghanistan Vet Cap, a perfect way to display your veteran status. This high-quality cap features raised 3-D embroidered “Afghanistan Veteran” lettering and a ribbon design prominently on the front center. For added detail, “Afghanistan Veteran” is also embroidered on the brim and “Afghanistan Vet” on the sandwich brim, creating a fully personalized look. Constructed from long-lasting brushed cotton twill, the cap is designed for durability and comfort.
description: Show your pride with Rothco’s Deluxe Low Profile Afghanistan Vet Cap, a perfect way to display your veteran status. This high-quality cap features raised 3-D embroidered “Afghanistan Veteran” lettering and a ribbon design prominently on the front center. For added detail, “Afghanistan Veteran” is also embroidered on the brim and “Afghanistan Vet” on the sandwich brim, creating a fully personalized look. Constructed from long-lasting brushed cotton twill, the cap is designed for durability and comfort. An internal sweatband helps prevent moisture from reaching your eyes, making it a perfect companion for hot days or outdoor activities. Ventilation holes on the top of the cap keep you cool, ensuring breathability during extended wear. With an adjustable hook and loop strap, the cap fits most head sizes comfortably, making it ideal for everyday wear. Whether you're relaxing or on the go, this cap serves as a proud reminder of your service. Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions. Whether you’re tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas, or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, our diverse range of headwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
